title: Refined upper bounds for the numerical radius via weighted operator means
summary: We establish a parameterized family of upper bounds for the numerical radius of bounded linear operators on a complex Hilbert space, based on weighted expressions involving the modulus of an operator and its adjoint. The proposed estimates encompass a known numerical-radius inequality as a particular symmetric case, while optimization over the weight parameter provides additional flexibility and can lead to sharper bounds.
